site.name: weaveapi
site.summary: weaveapi-clone Fictional payments API platform "WeaveAPI" developer docs (Stripe-style). Pages (shared docs three-column layout: left nav / center body / right try-it or anchors) | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Docs home: Quickstart, Authentication, Idempotency, Pagination, Errors sections + Popular guides 4 cards | | `quickstart.html` | Install + first-charge two-step example | | `charges.html` | Charges API: Charge object 18-field table + 5 endpoint sections (POST create / GET single / capture / refund / list), each section with parameter table + multi-lang code block + JSON response example; right-column try-it panel syncs with the current endpoint as you scroll, fill params + Send returns a mock response (`currency=usd/eur/gbp/jpy` returns a charge object, anything else returns `currency_not_supported`) |

run_plan.goal: Critique the UX of the full WeaveAPI developer docs by validating the primary learning flow (Quickstart → Charges → Customers → Webhooks → Errors) and adjacent recovery/edge paths (search, anchors/scroll syncing, Try-it parameterization, error handling, and mobile usability).
run_plan.summary: Start at index.html to verify global navigation, search, and the anchor-based “On this page” jump behavior. Then exercise the three-column doc experience across quickstart.html, charges.html, customers.html, webhooks.html, and errors.html—especially the “Try-it” style panel behavior on the Charges page. Finish by validating error reference clarity and repeat the most critical checks on a mobile viewport, focusing on small tap targets and any horizontal overflow.
assumptions: All listed HTML files are reachable locally via file:// and have consistent left-nav/global controls (Search docs ctrl+K, theme toggle, section anchors).

The Charges page includes a right-column interactive “Try-it panel” that syncs to the current endpoint section while scrolling and returns mock JSON responses based on entered parameters (e.g., currency).
No cross-origin network calls are required for the exploration; any interactive examples use local mock behavior rather than real API traffic.
risk_hotspots: index.html: Search docs… (ctrl+K) input usability and result navigation; also anchor links under “On this page” (Quickstart/Authentication/Idempotency/Pagination/Errors) to ensure correct scroll-to and state.
index.html: left nav items (e.g., Quickstart/Authentication/Charges/Customers/Webhooks/Errors) show mobile tap-target size warnings (223x31px) and may be hard to hit on mobile.

charges.html: right-column Try-it panel synchronization with the currently visible endpoint section (Create/Retrieve/Capture/Refund/List), plus parameter entry and Send response branching (supported currencies vs currency_not_supported).
charges.html, customers.html, webhooks.html: horizontal overflow warnings—validate that code blocks/tables are viewable and controls remain accessible without broken layout.
errors.html: error code table/entries clarity (type/code/message expectations) and ability to find specific codes via in-page navigation or search.
webhooks.html: signature verification and retries sections—validate that described flows are understandable and any linked references or anchors behave correctly.

phases.title: Global navigation & docs entry points (Index)
phases.objective: Validate that the entry page provides clear pathways into the docs, including search, anchors, and global navigation to adjacent flows.
key_checks: Use Search docs… (ctrl+K): type a query like “idempotency” or “pagination”, then select a result to confirm correct navigation/scroll.
Click primary section links (Quickstart, Authentication, Idempotency, Pagination, Errors) and verify the page scrolls to the correct section headings.
Click left-nav items to jump to other major pages (Charges, Customers, Error codes) and confirm full page navigation works.
Toggle the theme control (🌙) to ensure it doesn’t break readability or interactive controls.
exit_criteria: Search successfully navigates to relevant content on index.html.
At least 3 anchor clicks (e.g., Quickstart, Idempotency, Errors) land on the intended sections.
At least 2 left-nav page navigations (to charges.html/customers.html or errors.html) load correctly without layout breakage.

phases.title: Quickstart comprehension & copy-to-snippet UX
phases.objective: Check that the quickest path to value is understandable, with correct code snippets, language tabs, and copy controls.
key_checks: Verify step order: “1. Install the SDK” followed by “2. Make your first charge” is visually and semantically clear.
Use the code-language selectors (CURL/PYTHON/NODE/GO) and confirm displayed snippet updates appropriately.
Use the Copy button on the Quickstart snippets and verify it provides feedback (e.g., toast/state change).
Navigate back to the other major flows from visible links (e.g., Charges reference) and confirm continuity.
exit_criteria: Language switching changes the code block content without breaking layout.
Copy action works at least once and provides visible confirmation.
User can reach the Charges reference from Quickstart via link.

phases.title: Charges API: Try-it sync + endpoint parameterization
phases.objective: Exercise the Charges doc’s right-column Try-it panel behavior across multiple endpoints and validate edge-case responses.
key_checks: Scroll through endpoint sections in order: Create a charge, Retrieve a charge, Capture a charge, Refund a charge, List charges; verify the right Try-it panel updates to match the current endpoint.
For Create: enter currency values shown as supported (usd/eur/gbp/jpy) and confirm Send returns a charge-like JSON object.
For Create: enter an unsupported currency and confirm Send returns currency_not_supported (as described in the prescan summary).
For List charges: set cursor/pagination-related parameters (as visible in the panel) and verify response includes paging fields like has_more/next_cursor (as described).
Validate at least one Copy action for code blocks in the Charges page.
exit_criteria: Try-it panel clearly tracks the active endpoint section while scrolling.
Send produces correct mock responses for both supported and unsupported currency cases.
At least one pagination/list interaction results in a response containing pagination indicators.

phases.title: Customers & Webhooks: object understanding, anchors, and overflow resilience
phases.objective: Validate adjacent resource docs and ensure the 3-column layout remains usable with tables/code blocks and interactive controls.
key_checks: Customers: verify the Charge/Customer object framing is clear (“The Customer object” section) and navigate through Create/Retrieve/Update/Delete/List sections via scroll/anchors.
Customers: exercise Copy and any language tabs if present, ensuring code blocks remain readable.
Webhooks: confirm the presence and comprehension of event types list (e.g., charge.succeeded/charge.failed) and anchors for “Verifying signatures” and “Retries”.

Webhooks: validate any signature verification instructions are readable without horizontal scrolling breaking layout; address any horizontal_overflow warnings by checking code/table legibility and button accessibility.
exit_criteria: Users can successfully locate and read key sections (object description + CRUD/list on customers; event types + verifying/retries on webhooks).
No unusable horizontal overflow: code/tables and controls remain accessible without clipping.

phases.title: Errors reference clarity & mobile regression pass
phases.objective: Confirm errors are easy to interpret programmatically and display-wise, then repeat critical UX checks on mobile viewport.
key_checks: Errors: locate at least 3 specific error codes listed in the prescan (e.g., card_declined, insufficient_funds, expired_card, fraud_blocked) and verify the mapping includes CODE, HTTP status, and how-to-handle guidance.
Errors: use Search docs on this page (if available globally) to jump directly to an error code by name.
Mobile viewport: repeat index anchor navigation (Quickstart/Idempotency/Errors) and verify tap targets are usable despite small tap target warnings.
Mobile viewport: on charges.html, verify Try-it panel is still usable for at least one endpoint and that Send/currency edge-case behavior still works.
exit_criteria: Error codes table provides clear code + HTTP status + actionable handling for at least 3 codes.
Mobile: critical navigation (search/anchors) works without mis-taps or clipped controls.
Mobile: Charges Try-it remains functional for at least one endpoint (supported vs unsupported currency).

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all known HTML pages: index.html, quickstart.html, charges.html, customers.html, webhooks.html, errors.html.
coverage_targets.features: Exercise most visible controls per key page: Search docs (ctrl+K), theme toggle (🌙), language tabs (CURL/PYTHON/NODE/GO) where present, Copy buttons on code blocks, anchor navigation, and the Charges Try-it panel Send behavior across multiple endpoints.
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical checks on mobile viewport: index anchor navigation + search, plus Charges Try-it panel Send with at least one supported and one unsupported currency case. Also verify resilience against small tap targets and horizontal_overflow.

notes: Keep exploration within the prescan-visible surfaces: three-column layout (left nav/center content/right panel) and the Charges page’s scrolling-synced Try-it behavior.
Prioritize validations that can fail silently: anchor targeting, Try-it endpoint sync, Copy feedback, and responsiveness issues (small tap targets and horizontal_overflow warnings).

prescan_summary.title: WeaveAPI — Threads of value, woven simple
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Accept your first payment in 5 minutes. WeaveAPI is a payments-as-an-API platform built for backend engineers who want to ship value capture without inheriting a banking compliance department. Quickstart The most basic flow: collect a payment method, create a charge, capture funds. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc" \ -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \ -d amount=2000 -d currency=usd -d payment_method=pm_card_visa Copy Authentication WeaveAPI uses API keys. Test keys are prefixed sk_test_; live keys are sk_live_. Send your key in the Authorization header as a bearer token. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https:
headings: Accept your first payment in 5 minutes.

prescan_summary.title: Errors — WeaveAPI
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Error codes All WeaveAPI errors are returned as a structured object. Use code for programmatic handling and message for display. CODE HTTP MESSAGE HOW TO HANDLE card_declined 402 The card was declined Surface a retry; offer alternate payment method insufficient_funds 402 Insufficient funds on the card Retry with a different method expired_card 402 The card has expired Prompt user to update the card incorrect_cvc 402 CVC check failed Re-ask for the CVC processing_error 502 Issuer was unreachable Safe to retry with idempotency key fraud_blocked 402 Blocked by our risk system Do not retry; escalate via dashboard three_d_secure_required 402 3DS authentication required Redirect to three_d_secure.url

prescan_summary.title: Webhooks — WeaveAPI
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Webhooks WeaveAPI sends HTTP POST callbacks to your endpoint when interesting events happen. Each event is signed; verify before processing. Event types EVENT DESCRIPTION charge.succeeded A charge transitioned to succeeded charge.failed A charge transitioned to failed charge.refunded Full or partial refund applied charge.disputed Buyer opened a dispute charge.dispute.closed Dispute resolved (won or lost) customer.created New customer record customer.updated Customer attributes changed customer.deleted Customer was deleted payment_method.attached PM linked to a customer payment_method.detached PM unlinked invoice.created New invoice generated invoice.finalized Invoice is no longer draft invoice.

observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc" \ -d amount=2000 -d currency=usd -d payment_method=pm_card_visa Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges/ch_3OZ9aB -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges/ch_3OZ9aB/capture -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" -d amount=1500 Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges/ch_3OZ9aB/refund -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" -d amount=500 Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl "https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges?customer=cus_abc&limit=10" -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Error codes All WeaveAPI errors are returned as a structured object. Use code for programmatic handling and message for display. CODE HTTP MESSAGE HOW TO HANDLE card_declined 402 The card was declined Surface a retry; offer alternate payment method insufficient_funds 402 Insufficient funds on the card Retry with a different method expired_card 402 The card has expired Prompt user to update the card incorrect_cvc 402 CVC check failed Re-ask for the CVC processing_error 502 Issuer was unreachable Safe to retry with idempotency key fraud_blocked 402 Blocked by our risk system Do not retry; escalate via dashboard three_d_secure_required 402 3DS authentication required Redirect to three_d_secure.url currency_not_supported 400 Currency not enabled on account Enable currency in dashboard amount_too_small 400 Below minimum charge amount Increase amount (min $0.50 USD) amount_too_large 400 Above per-transaction maximum Split the charge missing_required_param 400 Required parameter omitted Check the error param invalid_param 400 Parameter value was invalid See param and message resource_missing 404 No such resource Check the ID resource_already_exists 409 Duplicate idempotency key with different params Use a new idempotency key authentication_required 401 Missing or invalid API key Send Authorization: Bearer sk_… permission_denied 403 API key lacks scope Grant scope in dashboard rate_limited 429 Too many requests Back off; respect Retry-After account_inactive 403 Account is closed or suspended Contact support refund_too_large 400 Refund exceeds refundable amount Check amount_refunded charge_already_captured 400 Charge was already captured No action needed charge_already_refunded 400 Charge fully refunded No action needed customer_max_payment_methods 400 Cannot attach more methods (limit 25) Detach unused methods idempotency_key_in_use 409 Key in use for in-flight request Wait and retry the same key invalid_webhook_signature 400 Webhook HMAC didn't match Check signing secret service_unavailable 503 Temporary outage Retry with backoff; check status page

observation.title: Webhooks — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Webhooks WeaveAPI sends HTTP POST callbacks to your endpoint when interesting events happen. Each event is signed; verify before processing. Event types EVENT DESCRIPTION charge.succeeded A charge transitioned to succeeded charge.failed A charge transitioned to failed charge.refunded Full or partial refund applied charge.disputed Buyer opened a dispute charge.dispute.closed Dispute resolved (won or lost) customer.created New customer record customer.updated Customer attributes changed customer.deleted Customer was deleted payment_method.attached PM linked to a customer payment_method.detached PM unlinked invoice.created New invoice generated invoice.finalized Invoice is no longer draft invoice.paid Invoice transitioned to paid invoice.payment_failed Charge attempt failed for invoice subscription.created New subscription subscription.updated Plan / quantity / proration change subscription.canceled Subscription ended Verifying signatures Each webhook includes a WeaveAPI-Signature header: t=<unix-ts>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256>. Recompute the HMAC over "<t>.<body>" using your webhook signing secret and constant-time compare. CURL PYTHON NODE GO # verify via openssl + sha256 echo -n "$timestamp.$body" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$WEBHOOK_SECRET" Copy Retries We retry non-2xx responses with exponential backoff for up to 72 hours (max 24 attempts). Respond with 200 as soon as the event is enqueued — don't block on heavy work in the request handler. ON THIS PAGE Event types Verifying signatures Retries

observation.title: WeaveAPI — Threads of value, woven simple
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Accept your first payment in 5 minutes. WeaveAPI is a payments-as-an-API platform built for backend engineers who want to ship value capture without inheriting a banking compliance department. Quickstart The most basic flow: collect a payment method, create a charge, capture funds. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc" \ -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \ -d amount=2000 -d currency=usd -d payment_method=pm_card_visa Copy Authentication WeaveAPI uses API keys. Test keys are prefixed sk_test_; live keys are sk_live_. Send your key in the Authorization header as a bearer token. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges/ch_3OZ9aB \ -u sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc: Copy Idempotency Every state-changing request accepts an Idempotency-Key header. Retry safely: a retry with the same key returns the original response, even if your client retried after a timeout. Pagination List endpoints use cursor-based pagination. has_more tells you when you've reached the end; next_cursor is the opaque token for the next page. Errors WeaveAPI returns conventional HTTP status codes plus a structured error object with type, code, and message. Full list → Popular guides Charges API → Create, capture, list, refund. Customers API → Save methods, manage profiles. Webhooks → Listen for events, sign requests. Error reference → 25+ error codes with hints. ON THIS PAGE Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination Errors Popular guides

observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc" \ -d amount=2000 -d currency=usd -d payment_method=pm_card_visa Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges/ch_3OZ9aB -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges/ch_3OZ9aB/capture -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" -d amount=1500 Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges/ch_3OZ9aB/refund -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" -d amount=500 Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl "https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges?customer=cus_abc&limit=10" -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. Recent (last 3)

CODE HTTP MESSAGE HOW TO HANDLE card_declined 402 The card was declined Surface a retry; offer alternate payment method insufficient_funds 402 Insufficient funds on the card Retry with a different method expired_card 402 The card has expired Prompt user to update the card incorrect_cvc 402 CVC check failed Re-ask for the CVC processing_error 502 Issuer was unreachable Safe to retry with idempotency key fraud_blocked 402 Blocked by our risk system Do not retry; escalate via dashboard three_d_secure_required 402 3DS authentication required Redirect to three_d_secure.url currency_not_supported 400 Currency not enabled on account Enable currency in dashboard amount_too_small 400 Below minimum charge amount Increase amount (min $0.50 USD) amount_too_large 400 Above per-transaction maximum Split the charge missing_required_param 400 Required parameter omitted Check the error param invalid_param 400 Parameter value was invalid See param and message resource_missing 404 No such resource Check the ID resource_already_exists 409 Duplicate idempotency key with different params Use a new idempotency key authentication_required 401 Missing or invalid API key Send Authorization: Bearer sk_… permission_denied 403 API key lacks scope Grant scope in dashboard rate_limited 429 Too many requests Back off; respect Retry-After account_inactive 403 Account is closed or suspended Contact support refund_too_large 400 Refund exceeds refundable amount Check amount_refunded charge_already_captured 400 Charge was already captured No action needed charge_already_refunded 400 Charge fully refunded No action needed customer_max_payment_methods 400 Cannot attach more methods (limit 25) Detach unused methods idempotency_key_in_use 409 Key in use for in-flight request Wait and retry the same key invalid_webhook_signature 400 Webhook HMAC didn't match Check signing secret service_unavailable 503 Temporary outage Retry with backoff; check status page

observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Accept your first payment in 5 minutes. WeaveAPI is a payments-as-an-API platform built for backend engineers who want to ship value capture without inheriting a banking compliance department. Quickstart The most basic flow: collect a payment method, create a charge, capture funds. CURL PYTHON NODE GO from weave import Weave client = Weave("sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc") charge = client.charges.create( amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa", description="UXBench demo charge", ) print(charge.id, charge.status) Copy Authentication WeaveAPI uses API keys. Test keys are prefixed sk_test_; live keys are sk_live_. Send your key in the Authorization header as a bearer token. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client = Weave(api_key="sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc") Copy Idempotency Every state-changing request accepts an Idempotency-Key header. Retry safely: a retry with the same key returns the original response, even if your client retried after a timeout. Pagination List endpoints use cursor-based pagination. has_more tells you when you've reached the end; next_cursor is the opaque token for the next page. Errors WeaveAPI returns conventional HTTP status codes plus a structured error object with type, code, and message. Full list → Popular guides Charges API → Create, capture, list, refund. Customers API → Save methods, manage profiles. Webhooks → Listen for events, sign requests. Error reference → 25+ error codes with hints. observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.refund("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=500) Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.list(customer="cus_abc", limit=10) Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response.
